risks.risk: Unselected exam board/year/route could cause wrong syllabus claims.
risks.control: Keep profiles as candidates until D-01 is answered; require year-compatible per-subject source references.
risks.closure_evidence: 2026-10-31 explicit user choice: Cambridge IGCSE 2028, science Extended; registered source IDs have compatible examination years. Document recheck/freeze remains P0-R06.

risks.control: Keep teaching content Draft; record actual review ownership before G0 passes.
risks.closure_evidence: Assignments for the four subjects, model and rights responsibilities; later independent reviews are separate evidence.

risks.risk: Illustrative kinetic parameters may be confused with experimentally fitted behaviour.
risks.control: Model/animation separation and explicit assumptions, limits and CSV metadata; no empirical validation claim.
risks.closure_evidence: Independent model review and correct labels; empirical validation remains a different claim.

risks.risk: Product CORE depth and exam-board Core/Extended terms may be conflated.
risks.control: Keep depth and exam classification separate in the planned P2 schema.
risks.closure_evidence: P2 data schema, validation and reviewed UI labels.

risks.risk: Desktop viewport tests may be mistaken for physical-device coverage.
risks.control: Label existing checks as viewport checks; require actual iPhone/Android evidence at the release gate.
risks.closure_evidence: Device, browser version, date and observed core flows recorded for physical devices.

risks.risk: Source versions and update notices may change; repeated official fetches were unstable.
risks.control: Record retrieval limits; recheck and freeze the selected documents and updates before P2 mapping.
risks.closure_evidence: Selected edition/version and matching update review, with a reproducible local evidence fingerprint.

risks.risk: Proposed beta counts could be presented as completed lessons or full coverage.
risks.control: Record current inventory separately from planned 12/4/32 totals; do not calculate syllabus coverage without a fixed denominator.
risks.closure_evidence: Release inventory backed by actual content records and review evidence.

risks.risk: Content-language choice could silently double writing and review scope.
risks.control: Leave teaching language undecided until D-02 is answered; preserve current English UI.
risks.closure_evidence: Recorded language decision and bounded localisation scope.
